title: 1998 AHSME Problem 4
statement: Define \([a,b,c]\) to mean \(\frac{a+b}{c},\) where \(c\ne0.\) What is the value of \[ [[60,30,90],[2,1,3],[10,5,15]]? \]

solutions.text: Each inner value is \(1:\) \(\frac{90}{90}=1,\frac{3}{3}=1,\) and \(\frac{15}{15}=1.\) Thus the outer expression is \([1,1,1]=\frac{1+1}{1}=2.\) The correct answer is E.
hints: Evaluate each of the three inner brackets first
All three inner brackets have the same value
